teaser: Why a small set of deliberate constraints often makes a site easier to maintain and nicer to read.
author: administrator
body:
Constraints are useful when they remove decisions that do not add value. A restrained type scale, a narrow reading width and a small colour palette create consistency without requiring a design system the size of the product.

Make the default good

Most pages should look finished before an editor touches presentation settings. That leaves the author free to focus on title, teaser and body content.

This profile follows that idea: the templates define the rhythm, while each article only supplies its content.
title: Designing with constraints
